svg.title: Effective potential, disk redshift and plunge
svg.desc: Effective potential of a massive particle around a Schwarzschild black hole, the redshift and intensity of a ring of disk gas, and the exponential approach of a plunging body to the horizon.
svg.text: Schwarzschild, G = c = M = 1: potential, Doppler beaming, plunge
Left: orbits sit at extrema of V; the ISCO is the inflection at r = 6. Middle: the approaching side is brighter by g^4. Right: the plunge clock matters by a factor of two.
azimuth phi around the ring (deg); 0 = receding, 180 = approaching
observer's time u = t - r*, slope -1/4
